Floods and landslides hit Arunachal Pradesh and Assam, affecting thousands

Heavy monsoon rains have caused severe flash floods and landslides across Arunachal Pradesh and Assam, impacting thousands of people. The natural disaster has led to damaged houses, washed-away bridges, and cut-off towns, prompting relief and rescue operations. Officials are assessing the situation and coordinating efforts to aid affected populations.
